headline: Fake PS5 emulators on GitHub found spreading password-stealing malware
summary: Malware disguised as two popular PS5 game emulators and distributed through GitHub has been identified as stealing passwords from gamers. NordVPN's threat research arm linked the malware to the fake emulators, which hit two well-known GitHub repositories, including the popular AnyPS5.

claims.statement: Malware disguised as fake PS5 emulators distributed via GitHub is stealing users' passwords.
